_help: Rules for the Etsy sync (scripts/etsy-sync.mjs); README.md explains each. A new listing's menu section comes from the first match in: titleRules (its Etsy title), tagRules (its tags), sectionCategories (its Etsy shop section), fallbackRules (title and tags), then defaultCategory. subjectRules: every subject whose words appear in the title, tags or section. After changing rules, run the workflow with 're-sort' ticked so pieces already on the site follow them. merge: an Etsy listing id that should join an existing product (listing id → product id). keepSeparate: listing ids never merged. skipTitles, ignoreListingIds: listings never added. maxNewPerRun, maxGonePerRun: safety stops.
